helmet_of_autonomy.description: The Helmet of Autonomy is an uncommon Helmet that grants the wearer Proficiency in Wisdom Saving Throws.

shadow_of_menzoberranzan.name: Shadow of Menzoberranzan
shadow_of_menzoberranzan.description: The Shadow of Menzoberranzan is a rare Helmet that allows the wearer to use Shrouded in Shadow to become Invisible.

helmet_of_grit.name: Helmet of Grit
helmet_of_grit.description: The Helmet of Grit is a very rare Helmet. It grants the wearer an additional Bonus Action at 50% or lower Hit Points.

adjustable_steel_helm.name: Adjustable Steel Helm
adjustable_steel_helm.description: Adjustable Steel Helm is a common Helmet.

blackplume_helm.name: Blackplume Helm
blackplume_helm.description: Blackplume Helm is a common Helmet, it provides minimal bonuses to a character but may be worn of aesthetic reasons.

blaze_portyr_s_ceremonial_flaming_fist_h.name: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm
blaze_portyr_s_ceremonial_flaming_fist_h.description: Blaze Portyr's Ceremonial Flaming Fist Helm is a common Helmet. It is a unique variant of Flaming Fist Helmet.

cracked_helm_of_shar.name: Cracked Helm of Shar
cracked_helm_of_shar.description: Cracked Helm of Shar is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

fierce_golden_helm.name: Fierce Golden Helm
fierce_golden_helm.description: A Fierce Golden Helm is a common Helmet.

flaming_fist_helmet.name: Flaming Fist Helmet
flaming_fist_helmet.description: A Flaming Fist Helmet is a common Helmet.

formidable_helmet.name: Formidable Helmet
formidable_helmet.description: A Formidable Helmet is a common Helmet.

goldgloss_heraldic_helm.name: Goldgloss Heraldic Helm
goldgloss_heraldic_helm.description: The Goldgloss Heraldic Helm is a common Helmet.

helmet.name: Helmet
helmet.description: A Helmet is a common Helmet.

justiciar_helmet.name: Justiciar Helmet
justiciar_helmet.description: A Justiciar Helmet is a common Helmet.

opulent_helmet.name: Opulent Helmet
opulent_helmet.description: Opulent Helm is a common Helmet, it provides minimal bonuses to a character but may be worn of aesthetic reasons.

regal_helm.name: Regal Helm
regal_helm.description: A Regal Helm is a common Helmet.

reinforced_helmet.name: Reinforced Helmet
reinforced_helmet.description: A Reinforced Helmet is a common Helmet.

scalpspike_helm.name: Scalpspike Helm
scalpspike_helm.description: Scalpspike Helm is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

shar_headwear.name: Shar Headwear
shar_headwear.description: Shar Headwear is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

triumphal_helm.name: Triumphal Helm
triumphal_helm.description: Triumphal Helm is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

watch_s_helmet.name: Watch's Helmet
watch_s_helmet.description: Watch's Helmet is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.

well_crated_helm.name: Well Crated Helm
well_crated_helm.description: A Well Crated Helm is a common Helmet.

dark_justiciar_helm.name: Dark Justiciar Helm
dark_justiciar_helm.description: A Dark Justiciar Helm is an uncommon Helmet worn by Shar's Dark Justiciars that grants a bonus to Saving Throws while obscured by shadow.

helmet_of_smiting.name: Helmet of Smiting
helmet_of_smiting.description: The Helmet of Smiting is an uncommon Helmet which grants the wearer Temporary Hit Points whenever they apply a Condition using a Smite spell.

holy_lance_helm.name: Holy Lance Helm
holy_lance_helm.description: A Holy Lance Helm is an uncommon Helmet that potentially deals radiant damage to creatures that attack the wearer.

flawed_helldusk_helmet.name: Flawed Helldusk Helmet
flawed_helldusk_helmet.description: Flawed Helldusk Helmet is a rare Helmet crafted from Infernal Iron that improves the wearer's saving throws against spells by 2.

steelwatcher_helmet.name: Steelwatcher Helmet
steelwatcher_helmet.description: Steelwatcher Helmet is a rare Helmet that grants the wearer Darkvision and immunity to Blindness. It also grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

dark_justiciar_helmet.name: Dark Justiciar Helmet
dark_justiciar_helmet.description: The Dark Justiciar Helmet is a very rare Helmet that improves the wearer's Saving Throws against Spells and makes Critical Hits more likely while the wearer is obscured by darkness.

sarevok_s_horned_helmet.name: Sarevok's Horned Helmet
sarevok_s_horned_helmet.description: Sarevok's Horned Helmet is a very rare Headwear that grants Darkvision to its wearer and increases critical hit chance. You also cannot be Frightened.

helm_of_balduran.name: Helm of Balduran
helm_of_balduran.features: Balduran's Vitality, Balduran's Favour, Stun Immunity
helm_of_balduran.description: Helm of Balduran is a legendary Headwear once worn by the fabled founder of Baldur's Gate, Balduran, and grants hit points every turn along with stun and critical hit immunities.

grymskull_helm.name: Grymskull Helm
grymskull_helm.description: The Grymskull Helm is a very rare helmet that grants fire resistance and protects its wearer from critical hits. It also grants the Hunter's Mark spell.

bracing_band.name: Bracing Band
bracing_band.description: The Bracing Band is an uncommon Ring which makes the wearer more difficult to hit after they shove an enemy.

callous_glow_ring.name: Callous Glow Ring
callous_glow_ring.description: Callous Glow Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer to deal an additional 2 Radiant damage to illuminated creatures every time they deal damage.

caustic_band.name: Caustic Band
caustic_band.description: Caustic Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer 2 Acid damage with weapon attacks.

coruscation_ring.name: Coruscation Ring
coruscation_ring.description: Coruscation Ring is an uncommon ring that inflicts  Radiating Orb on creatures that the wearer deals spell damage to. The wearer must be illuminated for this effect to occur.

crusher_s_ring.name: Crusher's Ring
crusher_s_ring.description: Crusher's Ring is an uncommon Ring which grants additional speed to the wearer.

djinni_ring.name: Djinni Ring
djinni_ring.description: Djinni Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Mage Hand.

eversight_ring.name: Eversight Ring
eversight_ring.description: Eversight Ring is an uncommon Ring that imparts immunity to  Blindness upon the wearer.

explorer_s_ring.name: Explorer's Ring
explorer_s_ring.description: The Explorer's Ring is an uncommon Ring that improves the wearer's knowledge of Nature and Survival.

family_ring.name: Family Ring
family_ring.description: The Family Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants +2 to Death Saving Throws.

firzu_s_ring_of_trading.name: Firzu's Ring of Trading
firzu_s_ring_of_trading.description: Firzu's Ring of Trading is an uncommon Ring that grants +1 to Deception.

guild_ring.name: Guild Ring
guild_ring.description: Guild Ring is a story-related Ring found in Act 3.

mage_s_friend.name: Mage's Friend
mage_s_friend.description: Mage's Friend is an uncommon Ring that improves the wearer's knowledge of Arcana and Religion.

poisoner_s_ring.name: Poisoner's Ring
poisoner_s_ring.description: The Poisoner's Ring is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast Virulent Venom.

ring_of_absolute_force.name: Ring of Absolute Force
ring_of_absolute_force.description: The Ring of Absolute Force is an uncommon Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Thunderwave spell and deal 1 additional thunder damage if they have the Absolute's Brand.

ring_of_colour_spray.name: Ring of Colour Spray
ring_of_colour_spray.description: Ring of Colour Spray is an uncommon Ring which allows the wearer to cast  Colour Spray once per short rest.

ring_of_elemental_infusion.name: Ring of Elemental Infusion
ring_of_elemental_infusion.description: The Ring of Elemental Infusion is an uncommon Ring that infuses your weapon with the element of your spells or cantrips, dealing additional damage.

ring_of_flinging.name: Ring of Flinging
ring_of_flinging.description: Ring of Flinging is an uncommon Ring that improves the throwing damage.

ring_of_geniality.name: Ring of Geniality
ring_of_geniality.description: Ring of Geniality is an uncommon Ring that grants a boost to Persuasion and Deception.

ring_of_jumping.name: Ring of Jumping
ring_of_jumping.description: Ring of Jumping is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Enhance Leap once per Short Rest.

ring_of_mental_inhibition.name: Ring of Mental Inhibition
ring_of_mental_inhibition.description: Ring of Mental Inhibition is an uncommon Ring that places a mentally weakening condition on enemies who fail to Save against spells and abilities.

ring_of_salving.name: Ring of Salving
ring_of_salving.description: The Ring of Salving is an uncommon Ring that restore addtional hit points every time the wearer heals another creature.

ring_of_self_immolation.name: Ring of Self Immolation
ring_of_self_immolation.description: The Ring of Self Immolation is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to use the Self Immolation ability to gain the  Heat condition.

ring_of_shadows.name: Ring of Shadows
ring_of_shadows.description: The Ring of Shadows is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast  Pass Without Trace once per Long Rest.

ring_of_spiteful_thunder.name: Ring of Spiteful Thunder
ring_of_spiteful_thunder.description: The Ring of Spiteful Thunder is a uncommon Ring that may  Daze Reverberating creatures upon which the wearer deals ⁠Thunder damage.

seemingly_gleaming_ring.name: Seemingly Gleaming Ring
seemingly_gleaming_ring.description: Seemingly Gleaming Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants +1 to Charisma Saving Throws and a -1 to Wisdom Saving Throws.

shadow_blade_ring.name: Shadow Blade Ring
shadow_blade_ring.description: Shadow Blade Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Shadow Blade. It is a reward for completing the quest Find Arabella's Parents.

shadow_cloaked_ring.name: Shadow-Cloaked Ring
shadow_cloaked_ring.description: The Shadow-Cloaked Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks to deal an additional 1d4 damage against Obscured or shadow creatures.

shapeshifter_s_boon_ring.name: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring
shapeshifter_s_boon_ring.description: Shapeshifter's Boon Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer +1d4 on all checks made while shapeshifted or disguised.

smuggler_s_ring.name: Smuggler's Ring
smuggler_s_ring.description: Smuggler's Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer bonuses to Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

snowburst_ring.name: Snowburst Ring
snowburst_ring.description: Snowburst Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer to create a 4.5m / 15ft circle of ice around their target when dealing Cold damage.

spurred_band.name: Spurred Band
spurred_band.description: The Spurred Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer Momentum while greatly injured.

strange_conduit_ring.name: Strange Conduit Ring
strange_conduit_ring.description: The Strange Conduit Ring is a uncommon Ring that grants additional Psychic damage to the wearer's weapon while Concentrating.

sunwalker_s_gift.name: Sunwalker's Gift
sunwalker_s_gift.description: Sunwalker's Gift is an uncommon Ring that grants a creature darkvision.

the_sparkswall.name: The Sparkswall
the_sparkswall.description: The Sparkswall is an uncommon Ring that shields the wearer from Lightning.

the_whispering_promise.name: The Whispering Promise
the_whispering_promise.description: The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer.

after_death_do_us_part.name: After Death Do Us Part
after_death_do_us_part.description: After Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring which allows its wearer to regain half their hit points after being  Downed, but be cursed with  Shadow Possession.

band_of_the_mystic_scoundrel.name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
band_of_the_mystic_scoundrel.description: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast illusion or enchantment spells as a bonus action after hitting a creature with a weapon attack.

fetish_of_callarduran_smoothhands.name: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands
fetish_of_callarduran_smoothhands.description: The Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Invisibility spell once per Long Rest.

keepsake_ring.name: Keepsake Ring
keepsake_ring.description: Keepsake Ring is a rare Ring that allows its wearer to cast  Dominate Beast as a 5th level spell once per Long Rest.

ring_of_arcane_synergy.name: Ring of Arcane Synergy
ring_of_arcane_synergy.description: Ring of Arcane Synergy is a rare Ring. It grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer deals damage with a cantrip.

ring_of_blink.name: Ring of Blink
ring_of_blink.description: The Ring of Blink is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Blink once per Long Rest.

ring_of_exalted_marrow.name: Ring of Exalted Marrow
ring_of_exalted_marrow.description: Ring of Exalted Marrow is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Exhort the Risen and Ghoulish Touch.

ring_of_free_action.name: Ring of Free Action
ring_of_free_action.description: Ring of Free Action is a rare Ring which allows the wearer to ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain and confers immunity to  Paralysis and being  Restrained.

ring_of_mind_shielding.name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
ring_of_mind_shielding.description: The Ring of Mind-Shielding is a rare Ring that gives advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.

ring_of_poison_resistance.name: Ring of Poison Resistance
ring_of_poison_resistance.description: The Ring of Poison Resistance is a rare Ring that grants the wearer Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: The Ring of Protection is a rare Ring that grants the wearer a bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving throws.

ring_of_truthfulness.name: Ring of Truthfulness
ring_of_truthfulness.description: Ring of Truthfulness is a rare ring that grants its wearer  Advantage on  Insight checks.

ring_of_twilight.name: Ring of Twilight
ring_of_twilight.description: The Ring of Twilight is a rare Ring that increases the wearer's Armour Class while obscured.

risky_ring.name: Risky Ring
risky_ring.description: The Risky Ring is a rare Ring. The wearer gains  Advantage on  Attack rolls but receives  Disadvantage on  Saving throws.

shifting_corpus_ring.name: Shifting Corpus Ring
shifting_corpus_ring.description: The Shifting Corpus Ring is a rare Ring that grants the ability to cast Invisibility and Blur once per Long Rest.

till_death_do_us_part.name: Till Death Do Us Part
till_death_do_us_part.description: Til Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast  Beacon of Hope.

true_love_s_caress.name: True Love's Caress
true_love_s_caress.description: True Love's Caress is one of a matching pair of Rings that grants the wearer  Warding Bond.

true_love_s_embrace.name: True Love's Embrace
true_love_s_embrace.description: True Love's Embrace is one of a matching pair of Rings that lets the wearer cast  Warding Bond.

burnished_ring.name: Burnished Ring
burnished_ring.description: The Burnished Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Paralyzing Ray once per Long Rest.

crypt_lord_ring.name: Crypt Lord Ring
crypt_lord_ring.description: Crypt Lord Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Create Undead once per Long Rest.

killer_s_sweetheart.name: Killer's Sweetheart
killer_s_sweetheart.description: Killer's Sweetheart is a very rare Ring that makes the wearer's next Attack Roll a critical hit after killing a creature, once per Long Rest.

orphic_ring.name: Orphic Ring
orphic_ring.description: Orphic Ring is a very rare ring that grants its wearer the  Confusion (level 5) spell on a long rest cooldown.

ring_of_evasion.name: Ring of Evasion
ring_of_evasion.description: Ring of Evasion is a very rare Ring that grants the wearer Dextrous Evasion.

ring_of_feywild_sparks.name: Ring of Feywild Sparks
ring_of_feywild_sparks.description: Ring of Feywild Sparks is a very rare Ring. It forces Wild Magic Surges to always trigger while  Tides of Chaos feature is active. It also grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

ring_of_regeneration.name: Ring of Regeneration
ring_of_regeneration.description: Ring of Regeneration is a very rare Ring that heals the wearer at the beginning of their turn while in combat.

guiding_light.name: Guiding Light
guiding_light.description: The Guiding Light is an story-related Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Light cantrip.

aberration_hunters_amulet.name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
aberration_hunters_amulet.description: The Aberration Hunters' Amulet is an uncommon Amulet. It grants Githyanki wearing it  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws and aberrations have  Disadvantage on attacks against them. The wielder can gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls against Aberrations for 3 turns, once per Short Rest.[See: Bugs]

absolute_confidence_amulet.name: Absolute Confidence Amulet
absolute_confidence_amulet.description: The Absolute Confidence Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Performance checks at the cost of -1 to Intimidation checks.

absolute_s_talisman.name: Absolute's Talisman
absolute_s_talisman.description: Absolute's Talisman is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a self-only version of Aid, and grants Advantage on Death Saving Throws if they bear the Absolute's Brand.

amulet_of_elemental_torment.name: Amulet of Elemental Torment
amulet_of_elemental_torment.description: The Amulet of Elemental Torment is an uncommon Amulet that channels the effects of certain Surfaces into the wearer's spells.

amulet_of_misty_step.name: Amulet of Misty Step
amulet_of_misty_step.description: Amulet of Misty Step is an uncommon amulet that grants its wearer the Misty Step spell on a short rest cooldown.

amulet_of_sel_ne_s_chosen.name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
amulet_of_sel_ne_s_chosen.description: The Amulet of Selûne's Chosen is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Selûne's Dream once per Long Rest.

amulet_of_silvanus.name: Amulet of Silvanus
amulet_of_silvanus.description: The Amulet of Silvanus is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Lesser Restoration once per Short Rest.

amulet_of_the_unworthy.name: Amulet of the Unworthy
amulet_of_the_unworthy.description: The Amulet of the Unworthy is an uncommon Amulet that protects the wearer from ⁠Slashing damage, but leaves them vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

beastmaster_s_chain.name: Beastmaster's Chain
beastmaster_s_chain.description: Beastmaster's Chain is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Animal Friendship once per Long Rest.

broodmother_s_revenge.name: Broodmother's Revenge
broodmother_s_revenge.description: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison whenever they are healed.

fireheart.name: Fireheart
fireheart.description: Fireheart is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer 2 turns of  Heat when they take Fire damage.

frost_prince.name: Frost Prince
frost_prince.description: Frost Prince is an uncommon Amulet which grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Ice Knife spell.

hammergrim_mist_amulet.name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet
hammergrim_mist_amulet.description: The Hammergrim Mist Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Fog Cloud spell.

kill_collar.name: Kill Collar
kill_collar.description: Kill Collar is an uncommon Amulet that represents the collars used by Gortash to keep the Gondians within the Iron Foundry in check.

komira_s_locket.name: Komira's Locket
komira_s_locket.description: Komira's Locket is an uncommon Amulet given to the party by  Arabella's parents.Grants its wearer the ability to cast  Dancing Lights.

moondrop_pendant.name: Moondrop Pendant
moondrop_pendant.description: The Moondrop Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to avoid provoking Attacks of Opportunity when below 50% hit points.

necklace_of_elemental_augmentation.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
necklace_of_elemental_augmentation.description: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation is an uncommon Amulet that adds the Spellcasting Modifier to the damage when the wearer uses elemental damage with a cantrip.

pearl_of_power_amulet.name: Pearl of Power Amulet
pearl_of_power_amulet.description: The Pearl of Power Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wielder to restore a spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per Long Rest.

psychic_spark.name: Psychic Spark
psychic_spark.description: Psychic Spark is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a stronger version of  Magic Missile.

shar_s_temptation.name: Shar's Temptation
shar_s_temptation.description: Shar's Temptation is an Amulet that allows its wearer to cast  Charm Person once per Short Rest.

silver_pendant.name: Silver Pendant
silver_pendant.description: Silver Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Guidance.

spineshudder_amulet.name: Spineshudder Amulet
spineshudder_amulet.description: Spineshudder Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to inflict Reverberation when dealing damage with ranged spell attacks.

tarnished_charm.name: Tarnished Charm
tarnished_charm.description: The Tarnished Charm is an uncommon amulet that reduces the DC of the wearer's death saving throws.

the_blast_pendant.name: The Blast Pendant
the_blast_pendant.description: The Blast Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to focus and discharge their Lightning Charges to strengthen their next lightning spell.

the_ever_seeing_eye.name: The Ever-Seeing Eye
the_ever_seeing_eye.description: The Ever-Seeing Eye is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Protection from Evil and Good once per Short Rest.

amulet_of_branding.name: Amulet of Branding
amulet_of_branding.description: The Amulet of Branding is a rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Brand the Weak once per Long Rest.

amulet_of_restoration.name: Amulet of Restoration
amulet_of_restoration.description: Amulet of Restoration is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Healing Word and  Mass Healing Word once per Long Rest.

amulet_of_the_drunkard.name: Amulet of the Drunkard
amulet_of_the_drunkard.description: Amulet of the Drunkard is a rare amulet. It increases the duration of Drunk to 5 turns and causes the wearer to regain 2d4 hit points once, during the first turn of  Drunk that occurs with this item equipped.

amulet_of_the_harpers.name: Amulet of the Harpers
amulet_of_the_harpers.description: Amulet of the Harpers is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shield once per Long Rest and grants Advantage with Wisdom Saving Throws.

champion_s_chain.name: Champion's Chain
champion_s_chain.description: Champion's Chain is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Intimidation.

chancer_s_carcanet.name: Chancer's Carcanet
chancer_s_carcanet.description: Chancer's Carcanet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to use a reaction to make an  Attack roll or  Saving throw with  Advantage, once per Long Rest.

envoy_s_amulet.name: Envoy's Amulet
envoy_s_amulet.description: Envoy's Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Persuasion.

periapt_of_wound_closure.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
periapt_of_wound_closure.description: Periapt of Wound Closure is a rare Amulet. Its wearer is automatically stabilised if  Downed at the start of their turn and the maximum the amount of hit points are restored to them when they receive healing.

sentient_amulet_rare.name: Sentient Amulet (Rare)
sentient_amulet_rare.spells: Shatter, Talk to the Sentient Amulet, Ki Restoration (Lesser)
sentient_amulet_rare.description: Sentient Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Short Rest (with a drawback) and  Ki Restoration (Lesser) once per Long Rest.

spell_savant_amulet.name: Spell Savant Amulet
spell_savant_amulet.description: Spell Savant Amulet is a rare Amulet that grants an additional Level 2 spell slot.

strange_tendril_amulet.name: Strange Tendril Amulet
strange_tendril_amulet.description: Strange Tendril Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Evard's Black Tentacles once per Long Rest.

surgeon_s_subjugation_amulet.name: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet
surgeon_s_subjugation_amulet.description: The Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet is a rare Amulet that, once per Long Rest, paralyses a humanoid on a Critical Hit.

the_amulet_of_lost_voices.name: The Amulet of Lost Voices
the_amulet_of_lost_voices.description: The Amulet of Lost Voices is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Speak with Dead once per Long Rest.

uncovered_mysteries.name: Uncovered Mysteries
uncovered_mysteries.description: Uncovered Mysteries is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest.

amulet_of_greater_health.name: Amulet of Greater Health
amulet_of_greater_health.description: Amulet of Greater Health is a very rare Amulet that can be obtained from the House of Hope.

amulet_of_the_devout.name: Amulet of the Devout
amulet_of_the_devout.description: The Amulet of the Devout is a very rare Amulet. It grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and, if the wearer has access to it, an additional use of  Channel Divinity Charge.

amulet_of_windrider.name: Amulet of Windrider
amulet_of_windrider.spells: Ride the Winds, Gust of Wind
amulet_of_windrider.description: Amulet of Windrider is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Ride the Winds and Gust of Wind. It is one of the rewards of the quest Save Vanra.

corvid_token.name: Corvid Token
corvid_token.description: Corvid Token is a very rare Amulet that increases jump distance and flying speed, grants the Polymorph: Dire Raven action, and grants Feather Fall to the wearer, which persists while Polymorphed or Wild Shaped.

fey_semblance_amulet.name: Fey Semblance Amulet
fey_semblance_amulet.description: Fey Semblance Amulet is a very rare Amulet that gives the user advantage on all mental saving throws.

khalid_s_gift.name: Khalid's Gift
khalid_s_gift.description: Khalid's Gift is a very rare Amulet that was gifted to Jaheira by Khalid and stored away in the basement of her home. While wearing it, Jaheira cannot be cursed.

sentient_amulet_very_rare.name: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)
sentient_amulet_very_rare.description: Sentient Amulet is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Long Rest and  Ki Restoration (Greater) once per Long Rest. It is a possible reward for the quest Help the Cursed Monk.

spellcrux_amulet.name: Spellcrux Amulet
spellcrux_amulet.description: Spellcrux Amulet is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to restore any one spell slot once per Long Rest.

the_spectator_eyes.name: The Spectator Eyes
the_spectator_eyes.description: The Spectator Eyes is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Ray of Fear and  Wounding Ray once per Long Rest.

tressym_collar.name: Tressym Collar
tressym_collar.description: Tressym Collar is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Telekinesis once per Long Rest.

unflinching_protector_amulet.name: Unflinching Protector Amulet
unflinching_protector_amulet.description: Unflinching Protector Amulet is a very rare Amulet that can be obtained from Ptaris.

amulet_of_bhaal.name: Amulet of Bhaal
amulet_of_bhaal.description: Amulet of Bhaal is a story-related Amulet which allows the wearer to inflict  Bleeding when hitting targets with maximum hit points. It also grants access to the Bhaal Temple.

broken_shield.name: Broken Shield
broken_shield.description: The Broken Shield is a common Shield that is severly damaged, providing less AC than regular shields.

fossilised_shell.name: Fossilised Shell
fossilised_shell.description: The Fossilised Shell is a common Shield worn by the primitive Kuo-toa of the Underdark.

iron_banded_shield.name: Iron-Banded Shield
iron_banded_shield.description: The Iron-Banded Shield is a common Shield.

metal_shield.name: Metal Shield
metal_shield.description: The Metal Shield is a common Shield emblazoned with the symbol of the Flaming Fist mercenaries.

organic_shield.name: Organic Shield
organic_shield.description: An Organic Shield is a common Shield.

rusty_studded_shield.name: Rusty Studded Shield
rusty_studded_shield.description: The Rusty Studded Shield is a common Shield.

scrapwood_shield.name: Scrapwood Shield
scrapwood_shield.description: A Scrapwood Shield is a common Shield used by goblins.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: A Shield is a common piece of defensive equipment wielded in one hand.

spiked_shield.name: Spiked Shield
spiked_shield.description: A Spiked Shield is a common Shield used by Goblins.

studded_shield.name: Studded Shield
studded_shield.description: A Studded Shield is a common Shield.

training_shield.name: Training Shield
training_shield.description: The Training Shield is a common Shield that is reserved for practice instead of real fighting. Considering it isn't sold anywhere, requires stealing and is inferior to other shields it can be considered little more than junk.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.

absolute_s_warboard.name: Absolute's Warboard
absolute_s_warboard.description: Absolute's Warboard is an uncommon Shield that improves a branded wearer's Saving Throws and allows them to cast Heroism once per Long Rest.

gloomstrand_shield.name: Gloomstrand Shield
gloomstrand_shield.description: Gloomstrand Shield is an uncommon Shield that adds +1 to Stealth

glowing_shield.name: Glowing Shield
glowing_shield.description: The Glowing Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants its user Temporary Hit Points once per Short Rest when they take damage while greatly injured.

ironvine_shield.name: Ironvine Shield
ironvine_shield.description: Ironvine Shield is an uncommon Shield that damages the attacker if the wielder is using a weapon empowered with Shillelagh.

safeguard_shield.name: Safeguard Shield
safeguard_shield.description: The Safeguard Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants you Saving Throws +1

the_real_sparky_sparkswall.name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
the_real_sparky_sparkswall.description: The Real Sparky Sparkswall is an uncommon Shield that allows the wearer to create a Lightning Aura.

watcher_s_shield.name: Watcher's Shield
watcher_s_shield.description: Watcher's Shield is an uncommon Shield that gives the wielder Advantage on Perception Checks.

wood_woad_shield.name: Wood Woad Shield
wood_woad_shield.description: Wood Woad Shield is an uncommon Shield found on Wood Woads and grants its wearer the ability to cast Woad's Ensnaring Strike.

absolute_s_protector.name: Absolute's Protector
absolute_s_protector.description: Absolute's Protector is a rare Shield that reduces damage from spells by 1 if the user bears the mark of the Absolute, grants Shield Bash, and allows the wielder to cast Fire Shield: Chill once per Long Rest.

adamantine_shield.name: Adamantine Shield
adamantine_shield.description: Adamantine Shield is a rare Shield that sends enemies Reeling when they miss you with a melee attack.

iron_banded_shield_1.name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
iron_banded_shield_1.description: Iron-Banded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its Armour Class bonus.

justiciar_s_greatshield.name: Justiciar's Greatshield
justiciar_s_greatshield.description: Justiciar's Greatshield is a rare Shield that allows the wielder to cast Darkness Cloak to hide themselves, and gains advantage on Perception checks.

ketheric_s_shield.name: Ketheric's Shield
ketheric_s_shield.description: Ketheric's Shield is a rare Shield that grants the action Shield Bash and improves your spellcasting-related rolls. It also gives you Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

sentinel_shield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinel_shield.description: Sentinel Shield is a rare Shield that provides the user +3 to Initiative rolls and advantage on Perception checks

shield_1.name: Shield +1
shield_1.description: A Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

shield_of_scorching_reprisal.name: Shield of Scorching Reprisal
shield_of_scorching_reprisal.description: Shield of Scorching Reprisal is a rare Shield that grants Fire Resistance, allows one to Shield Bash, and also apply Blazing Retaliation.

shield_of_shielding.name: Shield of Shielding
shield_of_shielding.description: Shield of Shielding is a rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Shield and use Shield Bash.

studded_shield_1.name: Studded Shield +1
studded_shield_1.description: A Studded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

abdel_s_trusted_shield.name: Abdel's Trusted Shield
abdel_s_trusted_shield.description: Abdel's Trusted Shield is a very rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Missiles once per Short Rest, as well as use Shield Bash.

shield_of_devotion.name: Shield of Devotion
shield_of_devotion.spells: Shield Blow, Shield of Devotion: Aid
shield_of_devotion.description: Shield of Devotion is a very rare Shield that grants a Level 1 Spell Slot, Shield Bash and allows the wielder to cast Shield of Devotion: Aid at Level 3 Spell once per Long Rest.

shield_of_the_undevout.name: Shield of the Undevout
shield_of_the_undevout.description: Shield of the Undevout is a very rare Shield that applies Disadvantage on Frightened Saving Throws to your foes and grants an additional level 1 spell slot. It also grants Shield Bash.

swires_sledboard.name: Swires' Sledboard
swires_sledboard.description: Swires' Sledboard is a very rare shield that grants the wearer Force Conduit at the start of combat. It also grants Shield Bash.

viconia_s_walking_fortress.name: Viconia's Walking Fortress
viconia_s_walking_fortress.spells: Bulwark Rebuke, Reflective Shell, Warding Bond
viconia_s_walking_fortress.description: Viconia's Walking Fortress is a legendary shield that can deal Force damage to the attacker when hit. Gives Advantage on saving throws against spells and Disadvantage to spell attacks made against the wearer.

simple_robe.name: Simple Robe
simple_robe.description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.

barbarian_clothes.name: Barbarian Clothes
barbarian_clothes.description: Barbarian Clothes are a common piece of Clothing.

armour_of_uninhibited_kushigo.name: Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo
armour_of_uninhibited_kushigo.description: The Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo is an uncommon piece of Clothing that allows the wearer to counter attack an enemy that misses them, so long as Patient Defence is active.

bided_time.name: Bided Time
bided_time.description: Bided Time is a set of uncommon Clothing that causes the wearer to gain Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

bloodguzzler_garb.name: Bloodguzzler Garb
bloodguzzler_garb.description: The Bloodguzzler Garb is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants its wearer Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

cloth_armour.name: Cloth Armour
cloth_armour.description: Cloth Armour is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

poisoner_s_robe.name: Poisoner's Robe
poisoner_s_robe.description: The Poisoner's Robe is an uncommon piece of Clothing that makes the wearer's poison spells deal more damage.

robe.name: Robe
robe.description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.

robe_of_summer.name: Robe of Summer
robe_of_summer.description: The Robe of Summer is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Resistance to Cold damage.

cloth_of_authority.name: Cloth of Authority
cloth_of_authority.description: Cloth of Authority is a rare piece of Clothing that grants immunity to emotion-altering conditions and grants +1 Armour Class and Advantage on Intimidation and Insight checks.

drunken_cloth.name: Drunken Cloth
drunken_cloth.description: Drunken Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws while Drunk. They also gain temporary hit points at the start of each turn.

enraging_heart_garb.name: Enraging Heart Garb
enraging_heart_garb.description: The Enraging Heart Garb is a rare piece of Clothing that grants Wrath while the wearer is Raging. It also increases Constitution by 2.

garb_of_the_land_and_sky.name: Garb of the Land and Sky
garb_of_the_land_and_sky.description: Garb of the Land and Sky is rare Clothing that grants the wearer Blade Ward when using Patient Defence. When using Step of the Wind, the wearer's next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

icebite_robe.name: Icebite Robe
icebite_robe.description: Icebite Robe is a rare piece of Clothing. It grants the wearer Resistance to Cold damage and allows them to cast Armour of Agathys as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

mutilated_carapace.name: Mutilated Carapace
mutilated_carapace.description: Mutilated Carapace is a rare piece of Clothing that grants its wearer a bonus to Attack Rolls and damage rolls while being disguised, as well as Advantage on Deception and Persuasion Ability Checks.

obsidian_laced_robe.name: Obsidian Laced Robe
obsidian_laced_robe.description: Obsidian Laced Robe is rare piece of Clothing that deals Fire damage to enemies on a successful Saving Throw against their spells, and grants its wearer resistance to Fire damage.

robe_of_exquisite_focus.name: Robe of Exquisite Focus
robe_of_exquisite_focus.description: The Robe of Exquisite Focus is a rare piece of Clothing that increases its wearer's Spell Save DC.

shelter_of_athkatla.name: Shelter of Athkatla
shelter_of_athkatla.description: Shelter of Athkatla is a rare Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage against spell Saving Throws, and grants the ability to cast Mirror Image

the_graceful_cloth.name: The Graceful Cloth
the_graceful_cloth.features: Cat's Grace, Nimble As a Cat
the_graceful_cloth.description: The Graceful Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing which gives its wearer +2 Dexterity and the Cat's Grace condition. It also boosts their Dexterity Saving Throws and jump distance.

the_mighty_cloth.name: The Mighty Cloth
the_mighty_cloth.description: The Mighty Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that gives its wearer +2 Strength (up to 20) and the Bull's Strength condition. Also grants the wearer the Bull Rush class action.

the_protecty_sparkswall.name: The Protecty Sparkswall
the_protecty_sparkswall.description: The Protecty Sparkswall is a rare Clothing that increases the wearer's defences while they have Lightning Charges and grants a +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC.

viconia_s_priestess_robe.name: Viconia's Priestess Robe
viconia_s_priestess_robe.description: Viconia's Priestess Robe is a rare Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured, and enhances Shield of Faith to give a +2 to all Saving Throws as well.

bonespike_garb.name: Bonespike Garb
bonespike_garb.description: Bonespike Garb is a very rare Clothing that grants temporary hit points when using Rage, and reduces incoming damage by 2. Attackers receive Piercing damage when the wearer is struck.

infernal_robe.name: Infernal Robe
infernal_robe.description: Infernal Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that makes its wearer resistant to Fire damage and grants the Fire Shield (Warm) at level 4, once per Long Rest.

moon_devotion_robe.name: Moon Devotion Robe
moon_devotion_robe.description: Moon Devotion Robe is a very rare Clothing that grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws and grants the ability to cast Produce Flame and Lunar Bulwark.

potent_robe.name: Potent Robe
potent_robe.description: The Potent Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that uses the wearer's Charisma modifier to increase their cantrips' damage as well as give them temporary hit points.

robe_of_supreme_defences.name: Robe of Supreme Defences
robe_of_supreme_defences.description: The Robe of Supreme Defences is a very rare Clothing that adds your Spellcasting Modifier to your Saving Throws, when you are concentrating on a spell.

robe_of_the_weave.name: Robe of the Weave
robe_of_the_weave.features: Weave Eater, Arcane Enchantment (Robe of the Weave)
robe_of_the_weave.description: Robe of the Weave is a very rare Clothing. It allows the wearer to heal when succeeding a saving throw against a spell, and boosts Spell Save DC and Spell Attack by 1 each.

veil_of_the_morning.name: Veil of the Morning
veil_of_the_morning.features: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
veil_of_the_morning.description: Veil of the Morning is a very rare Clothing that imposes Disadvantage on Undead Attack Rolls against the wearer, grants the wearer Advantage against Undead spells and actions, and allows the wearer to Turn Undead.

vest_of_soul_rejuvenation.name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation
vest_of_soul_rejuvenation.description: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation is a very rare Clothing that allows the wearer to heal on a successful saving throw against a spell, and can make an Unarmed Attack against any attacker that misses, using a Reaction.

wavemother_s_robe.name: Wavemother's Robe
wavemother_s_robe.description: Wavemother's Robe is a very rare Clothing which grants the wearer Resistance to Fire and Cold damage. The wearer also heals while standing in water and can cast Create or Destroy Water.

cape_of_the_red_prince.name: Cape of the Red Prince
cape_of_the_red_prince.description: Cape of the Red Prince is a common Cloak.

cloak.name: Cloak
cloak.description: Cloak is a common Cloak that provides no bonuses to the wearer.

cindermoth_cloak.name: Cindermoth Cloak
cindermoth_cloak.description: Cindermoth Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that inflicts Burning on any foe within 2m / 7ft which damages the wearer.

cloak_of_cunning_brume.name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
cloak_of_cunning_brume.description: Cloak of Cunning Brume is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user a  smokescreen cloud effect when trying to  Disengage.

cloak_of_elemental_absorption.name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption
cloak_of_elemental_absorption.description: Cloak of Elemental Absorption is an uncommon Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: Cloak of Protection is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user +1  Armour Class and +1 to  Saving throws

fleshmelter_cloak.name: Fleshmelter Cloak
fleshmelter_cloak.description: Fleshmelter Cloak is an uncommon Cloak. It deals acid damage to creatures that deal melee damage to the wearer.

reverse_rain_cloak.name: Reverse Rain Cloak
reverse_rain_cloak.description: Reverse Rain Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the user the condition  Wet while worn, increasing resistance to ⁠Fire, but granting vulnerability to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Cold damage.

thunderskin_cloak.name: Thunderskin Cloak
thunderskin_cloak.description: Thunderskin Cloak is an uncommon Cloak which has a chance to  Daze creatures that are  Reverberating when they damage the wearer.

vivacious_cloak.name: Vivacious Cloak
vivacious_cloak.description: Vivacious Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the wearer 8 temporary Hit Points when casting a spell in melee.

cloak_of_displacement.name: Cloak of Displacement
cloak_of_displacement.description: Cloak of Displacement is a rare Cloak that, every turn, subjects enemy attacks against its wearer to Disadvantage until the wearer takes damage.

derivation_cloak.name: Derivation Cloak
derivation_cloak.description: Derivation Cloak is a rare Cloak which heals the wearer for 1d4 Hit Points when they Poison a foe.

the_deathstalker_mantle.name: The Deathstalker Mantle
the_deathstalker_mantle.description: The Deathstalker Mantle is a rare Cloak that turns the wearer Invisible for 2 turns after killing an enemy.

wavemother_s_cloak.name: Wavemother's Cloak
wavemother_s_cloak.description: Wavemother's Cloak is a rare Cloak that grants its wearer Water Layer Protection every turn.

cloak_of_the_weave.name: Cloak of the Weave
cloak_of_the_weave.description: Cloak of the Weave is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack. It also gives better Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.

mantle_of_the_holy_warrior.name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
mantle_of_the_holy_warrior.description: The Mantle of the Holy Warrior is a Very Rare Cloak that grants the wearer the ability to cast Crusader's Mantle.

nymph_cloak.name: Nymph Cloak
nymph_cloak.description: Nymph Cloak is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to cast Dominate Person once per Long Rest.

shade_slayer_cloak.name: Shade-Slayer Cloak
shade_slayer_cloak.description: Shade-Slayer Cloak is a very rare Cloak that reduces the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while hiding.

drow_leather_gloves.name: Drow Leather Gloves
drow_leather_gloves.description: Drow Leather Gloves are a common pair of Gloves worn by the Drow.

druidic_bracers.name: Druidic Bracers
druidic_bracers.description: Druidic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

gloves_equipment.name: Gloves (Equipment)
gloves_equipment.description: Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

leather_bracers.name: Leather Bracers
leather_bracers.description: Leather Bracers are a common pair of Gloves. These bracers offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

leather_gloves.name: Leather Gloves
leather_gloves.description: Leather Gloves are a common pair of Gloves. While coming in varying appearances, these gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell off.

nettie_s_gloves.name: Nettie's Gloves
nettie_s_gloves.description: Nettie's Gloves are a common pair of Gloves belonging to the Druid Nettie. These gloves offer no benefits beyond cosmetic appeal or as an item to sell.

braindrain_gloves.name: Braindrain Gloves
braindrain_gloves.description: Braindrain Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflicts Mental Fatigue on a foe whenever the wearer deals ⁠Psychic damage to them.

dark_justiciar_gauntlets_uncommon.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon)
dark_justiciar_gauntlets_uncommon.description: The Dark Justiciar Gauntlets are an uncommon pair of Gloves that cause weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.

fleetfingers.name: Fleetfingers
fleetfingers.description: The Fleetfingers are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to Jump after using Dash without costing a bonus action.

gloves_of_archery.name: Gloves of Archery
gloves_of_archery.description: Gloves of Archery are an uncommon Gloves that grants the wearer Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, as well as +2 damage with ranged weapon attacks.

gloves_of_baneful_striking.name: Gloves of Baneful Striking
gloves_of_baneful_striking.description: The Gloves of Baneful Striking are an uncommon pair of Gloves that applies a penalty to its saving throws against the wearer's spells.

gloves_of_belligerent_skies.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies
gloves_of_belligerent_skies.description: The Gloves of Belligerent Skies are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflict Reverberation when the wearer deals Thunder, Lightning or Radiant damage.

gloves_of_hail_of_thorns.name: Gloves of Hail of Thorns
gloves_of_hail_of_thorns.description: Gloves of Hail of Thorns are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Hail of Thorns.

gloves_of_heroism.name: Gloves of Heroism
gloves_of_heroism.description: The Gloves of Heroism are an uncommon pair of gloves that grants their wearer Heroism whenever using Channel Oath spells.

gloves_of_power.name: Gloves of Power
gloves_of_power.description: Gloves of Power are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to inflict Bane on weapon attacks.

gloves_of_the_growling_underdog.name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog
gloves_of_the_growling_underdog.description: The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer  Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.

gloves_of_thievery.name: Gloves of Thievery
gloves_of_thievery.description: Gloves of Thievery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer  Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

hellrider_s_pride.name: Hellrider's Pride
hellrider_s_pride.description: The Hellrider's Pride are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant a creature resistance to the physical damage of weapon attacks when healed by the wearer of these gauntlets.

herbalist_s_gloves.name: Herbalist's Gloves
herbalist_s_gloves.description: The Herbalist's Gloves are an uncommon pair of gloves that cleanse poison from those the wearer heals.

ichorous_gloves.name: Ichorous Gloves
ichorous_gloves.description: Ichorous Gloves are an uncommon set of Gloves that can inflict Noxious Fumes on targets that are dealt Acid damage.

knock_knuckle_gloves.name: Knock Knuckle Gloves
knock_knuckle_gloves.description: Knock Knuckle Gloves are uncommon Gloves that grant the spell Knock and increases Sleight of Hand by 1.

luminous_gloves.name: Luminous Gloves
luminous_gloves.description: The Luminous Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that causes the wearer's Radiant damage to afflict struck foes with the Radiating Orb condition.

reason_s_grasp.name: Reason's Grasp
reason_s_grasp.description: Reason's Grasp are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer Temporary Hit Points if they choose to end their Rage.

thermoarcanic_gloves.name: Thermoarcanic Gloves
thermoarcanic_gloves.description: Thermoarcanic Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grants the wearer 2 turns of Heat whenever they deal Fire damage.

unlucky_thief_s_gloves.name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
unlucky_thief_s_gloves.description: Unlucky Thief's Gloves are an uncommon Gloves that grants the wearer +2 to Sleight of Hand checks.

winter_s_clutches.name: Winter's Clutches
winter_s_clutches.description: The Winter's Clutches are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Encrusted with Frost on enemies whenever they deal Cold damage.

bracers_of_defence.name: Bracers of Defence
bracers_of_defence.description: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.

cerebral_citadel_gloves.name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
cerebral_citadel_gloves.description: The Cerebral Citadel Gloves are rare gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws when a character Charms or Frightens a creature.

cindersnap_gloves.name: Cindersnap Gloves
cindersnap_gloves.description: Cindersnap Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grants the spell Protection from Missiles.

craterflesh_gloves.name: Craterflesh Gloves
craterflesh_gloves.description: Craterflesh Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that deal additional Force damage on a Critical Hit.

daredevil_gloves.name: Daredevil Gloves
daredevil_gloves.description: Daredevil Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance Spell Attack Rolls and enable casting spells without Disadvantage even when adjacent to an enemy.

dark_displacement_gloves.name: Dark Displacement Gloves
dark_displacement_gloves.description: Dark Displacement Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant their wearer +1 Sleight of Hand. They also give a +1 Attack Roll bonus when attacking with thrown weapons and swap positions with these targets if they fail a Dexterity Saving Throw.

dark_justiciar_gauntlets_rare.name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare)
dark_justiciar_gauntlets_rare.description: The Dark Justiciar Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that cause weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage. It also grants better Strength Saving Throws and allows the wearer to cast Beckoning Darkness once per turn.

flawed_helldusk_gloves.name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves
flawed_helldusk_gloves.description: Flawed Helldusk Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that grant 1d4 Fire damage to weapon attacks. Unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict Bleeding.

gloves_of_battlemage_s_power.name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
gloves_of_battlemage_s_power.description: Gloves of Battlemage's Power is a set of rare Gloves. They allow the wearer to gain Arcane Acuity whenever they hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon.

gloves_of_cinder_and_sizzle.name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle
gloves_of_cinder_and_sizzle.description: The Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle are a rare pair of Gloves that give the wearer Fire damage to their unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Scorching Ray once per Long Rest.

gloves_of_crushing.name: Gloves of Crushing
gloves_of_crushing.description: Gloves of Crushing are rare gloves that enhance unarmed attack rolls and grant bonus Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks.

gloves_of_missile_snaring.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
gloves_of_missile_snaring.description: Gloves of Missile Snaring is a rare pair of gloves that allows the wearer to use Missile Snaring to reduce incoming ranged damage as a Reaction.

gloves_of_the_automaton.name: Gloves of the Automaton
gloves_of_the_automaton.description: The Gloves of the Automaton are a rare pair of Gloves which, when activated, cause the wearer to be treated as a Construct and grant Advantage on weapon attacks for 10 turns.

gloves_of_the_balanced_hands.name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands
gloves_of_the_balanced_hands.description: Gloves of the Balanced Hands are a rare pair of Gloves that adds the wearer's Ability Modifier to damage when they make an attack with their off-hand weapon.

gloves_of_the_duellist.name: Gloves of The Duellist
gloves_of_the_duellist.description: Gloves of The Duellist are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance melee weapon Attack Rolls when the wearer only holds one weapon in the main hand.

gloves_of_uninhibited_kushigo.name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo
gloves_of_uninhibited_kushigo.description: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare pair of gloves that deals additional damage with Throw attacks and Improvised Weapons attacks.

jhannyl_s_gloves.name: Jhannyl's Gloves
jhannyl_s_gloves.description: Jhannyl's Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that lets the wearer automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves when they become Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned.

martial_exertion_gloves.name: Martial Exertion Gloves
martial_exertion_gloves.description: Martial Exertion Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to gain an additional attack and double its movement speed for one turn at the cost of taking some damage.

nimblefinger_gloves.name: Nimblefinger Gloves
nimblefinger_gloves.description: Nimblefinger Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant a Dexterity bonus to Gnomes, Halflings, and Dwarves, and a bonus to Sleight of Hand.

poisoner_s_gloves.name: Poisoner's Gloves
poisoner_s_gloves.description: Poisoner's Gloves are a rare set of Gloves which has a chance to poison a target every time it receives Poison damage.

raven_gloves.name: Raven Gloves
raven_gloves.description: Raven Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to summon a Raven.

seraphic_pugilist_gloves.name: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves
seraphic_pugilist_gloves.description: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that give additional 1d4 Radiant damage to unarmed attacks and give the ability to cast Guiding Bolt.

servitor_of_the_black_hand_gloves.name: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
servitor_of_the_black_hand_gloves.description: The Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that give additional Force damage to unarmed attacks and allows the wearer to cast Fear once per Long Rest.

snow_dusted_monastery_gloves.name: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves
snow_dusted_monastery_gloves.description: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that cause the wearer's unarmed attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Cold damage. It also grants the ability to cast Ice Knife as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

spellseeking_gloves.name: Spellseeking Gloves
spellseeking_gloves.description: Spellseeking Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to spend a Sorcery Point to gain Advantage when making a spell attack roll.

stalker_gloves.name: Stalker Gloves
stalker_gloves.features: Seldom Caught Unawares (Stalker Gloves), Skullduggery Attack
stalker_gloves.description: Stalker Gloves are a rare pair of gloves which improve the wearer's Sneak Attack and Initiative.

swordmaster_gloves.name: Swordmaster Gloves
swordmaster_gloves.description: The Swordmaster Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant proficiency in three types of sword and provide a bonus to melee Attack Rolls.

the_sparkle_hands.name: The Sparkle Hands
the_sparkle_hands.description: The Sparkle Hands are a pair of rare Gloves that grant Lightning Charges on unarmed attacks and provides Advantage against metal constructs and armoured foes while charged.

thunderpalm_strikers.name: Thunderpalm Strikers
thunderpalm_strikers.description: Thunderpalm Strikers are a rare pair of Gloves that add Thunder damage to unarmed attacks and allow the wearer to cast Thunderwave once per Long Rest.

winkling_gloves.name: Winkling Gloves
winkling_gloves.description: Winkling Gloves are a Rare pair of Gloves that improves your Attack Rolls and Sleight of Hand checks.

wondrous_gloves.name: Wondrous Gloves
wondrous_gloves.description: The Wondrous Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that increase AC and give Bards an additional Bardic Inspiration.

abyss_beckoners.name: Abyss Beckoners
abyss_beckoners.description: The Abyss Beckoners are a very rare pair of gloves which improve the damage resistance of summons at the risk of driving them Mad.

bhaalist_gloves.name: Bhaalist Gloves
bhaalist_gloves.description: Bhaalist Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to Garrotte a target.

bonespike_gloves.name: Bonespike Gloves
bonespike_gloves.description: Bonespike Gloves is a pair of very rare gloves that make your attacks ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.

gauntlet_of_the_tyrant.name: Gauntlet of the Tyrant
gauntlet_of_the_tyrant.description: Gauntlet of the Tyrant is a very rare Glove that grants +1 Spell Save DC and additional Force damage for unarmed attacks. Also grants the Command spell.

gauntlets_of_hill_giant_strength.name: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
gauntlets_of_hill_giant_strength.description: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength are very rare Gloves that can be obtained from the House of Hope. These gloves set the wearer's Strength ability score to 23.

gemini_gloves.name: Gemini Gloves
gemini_gloves.description: The Gemini Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant the wearer the ability to cast Cantrips which can target foes or allies twice.

gloves_of_dexterity.name: Gloves of Dexterity
gloves_of_dexterity.description: The Gloves of Dexterity are a very rare pair of gloves that give a character 18 Dexterity and increase their  Attack rolls by 1.

helldusk_gloves.name: Helldusk Gloves
helldusk_gloves.description: Helldusk Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant bonuses to spellcasting, weapon attacks, and unarmed attacks.

hr_a_cknir_bracers.name: Hr'a'cknir Bracers
hr_a_cknir_bracers.description: Hr'a'cknir Bracers is a very rare set of Gloves that allows the wearer to cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action and cast Telekinesis once per Short Rest.

quickspell_gloves.name: Quickspell Gloves
quickspell_gloves.description: Quickspell Gloves are a pair of Very Rare Gloves that grant the wearer the ability to cast a Cantrip as a Bonus Action instead of an Action, once per Short Rest.

spellmight_gloves.name: Spellmight Gloves
spellmight_gloves.description: Spellmight Gloves are a pair of very rare Gloves which allow the wearer to deal additional damage at the cost of accuracy.

gloves_of_soul_catching.name: Gloves of Soul Catching
gloves_of_soul_catching.description: The Gloves of Soul Catching are a legendary pair of Gloves. They grant additional Force damage to unarmed attacks, +2 Constitution, and heal the wearer after an unarmed attack.

metallic_gloves.name: Metallic Gloves
metallic_gloves.description: Metallic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

blackguard_s_gauntlets.name: Blackguard's Gauntlets
blackguard_s_gauntlets.description: Blackguard's Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gauntlets that grant their wearer +1 Attack, +1 Strength Saving Throws, and allows them to cast Inflict Wounds as a 4th level spell once per Long Rest.

gauntlets_of_surging_accuracy.name: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy
gauntlets_of_surging_accuracy.description: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy are a rare pair of gloves that give the wearer a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls for the rest of their turn when using Action Surge.

unwanted_masterwork_gauntlets.name: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets
unwanted_masterwork_gauntlets.description: Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that provides a bonus to Attack Rolls and Strength Saving Throws. It is part of the Unwanted set.

gauntlets_of_the_warmaster.name: Gauntlets of the Warmaster
gauntlets_of_the_warmaster.description: Gauntlets of the Warmaster are a very rare pair of Gauntlets. They grant their wielder +1 on Attack Rolls and subject the targets of their Manoeuvres to Disadvantage.

legacy_of_the_masters.name: Legacy of the Masters
legacy_of_the_masters.description: The Legacy of the Masters are a very rare pair of Gloves that grants the wearer +2 to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls.

the_reviving_hands.name: The Reviving Hands
the_reviving_hands.description: The Reviving Hands are a very rare pair of Gloves that grants the wearer the to ability to cast Revivify and applies Blade Ward and Death Ward to creatures healed or revived by the wearer respectively.

boots_of_aid_and_comfort.name: Boots of Aid and Comfort
boots_of_aid_and_comfort.description: Boots of Aid and Comfort are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant additional Temporary Hit Points to creatures healed by the wearer.

boots_of_stormy_clamour.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour
boots_of_stormy_clamour.description: Boots of Stormy Clamour are an uncommon pair of Boots that inflicts the  Reverberation condition on a creature when afflicting it with another condition.

boots_of_very_fast_blinking.name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
boots_of_very_fast_blinking.description: Boots of Very Fast Blinking are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant the wearer the ability to cast  Misty Step once per turn, but with the drawback that their clothes are left behind.

cinder_shoes.name: Cinder Shoes
cinder_shoes.description: Cinder Shoes is a pair of uncommon Boots that grants Heat whenever the wearer Burns an enemy.

hoarfrost_boots.name: Hoarfrost Boots
hoarfrost_boots.description: Hoarfrost Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to not slip on icy surfaces.

mystra_s_grace.name: Mystra's Grace
mystra_s_grace.description: Mystra's Grace is an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to cast the Feather Fall spell at will.

spiderstep_boots.name: Spiderstep Boots
spiderstep_boots.description: Spiderstep Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that allow the wearer to walk across webs freely.

tyrannical_jackboots.name: Tyrannical Jackboots
tyrannical_jackboots.description: Tyrannical Jackboots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant a +1 bonus to Charisma checks and Saving Throws.

varsh_ko_kuu_s_boots.name: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots
varsh_ko_kuu_s_boots.description: Varsh Ko'kuu's Boots are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant immunity to Acid surfaces and Resistance to Acid damage.

acrobat_shoes.name: Acrobat Shoes
acrobat_shoes.description: Acrobat Shoes is a pair of rare Boots that grants a bonus to Acrobatics and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

boots_of_apparent_death.name: Boots of Apparent Death
boots_of_apparent_death.description: Boots of Apparent Death are a rare set of Boots that grants the wearer the ability to cast Feign Death once per Short Rest.

boots_of_arcane_bolstering.name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering
boots_of_arcane_bolstering.description: Boots of Arcane Bolstering is a pair of rare Boots that grants Arcane Charge each time the wearer Dashes, adding +1 bonus to damage with spells while Threatened.

boots_of_brilliance.name: Boots of Brilliance
boots_of_brilliance.description: Boots of Brilliance are a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to replenish one Bardic Inspiration charge once per long rest.

boots_of_genial_striding.name: Boots of Genial Striding
boots_of_genial_striding.description: Boots of Genial Striding is a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to move over difficult terrain without impediment.

boots_of_speed.name: Boots of Speed
boots_of_speed.description: The Boots of Speed is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to click their heels for a burst of speed that makes it difficult for enemies to land Attacks of Opportunity on them.

boots_of_uninhibited_kushigo.name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo
boots_of_uninhibited_kushigo.description: The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add your Wisdom modifier to your unarmed strikes' damage.

evasive_shoes.name: Evasive Shoes
evasive_shoes.description: The Evasive Shoes are a rare pair of Boots that give a small bonus to Acrobatics and Armour Class.

linebreaker_boots.name: Linebreaker Boots
linebreaker_boots.description: The Linebreaker Boots are a rare pair of Boots that grants the wearer Wrath whenever they Dash.

slinging_shoes.name: Slinging Shoes
slinging_shoes.description: Slinging Shoes is a pair of Boots that deal psychic damage and return to the wearer when thrown.

spaceshunt_boots.name: Spaceshunt Boots
spaceshunt_boots.description: Spaceshunt Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to cast the Dimension Door spell as an Action once per Long Rest.

springstep_boots.name: Springstep Boots
springstep_boots.description: Springstep Boots is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to gain Momentum whenever they dash in combat, further improving their Movement Speed.

swiresy_shoes.name: Swiresy Shoes
swiresy_shoes.description: The Swiresy Shoes are a pair of rare Boots that improve Jumping distance and Acrobatics skill.

the_watersparkers.name: The Watersparkers
the_watersparkers.description: The Watersparkers are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to electrify water surfaces and gain Lightning Charges.

bonespike_boots.name: Bonespike Boots
bonespike_boots.description: Bonespike Boots are a Very rare pair of Boots that enhances jump distance and gives the character access to the Brutal Leap ability.

helldusk_boots.name: Helldusk Boots
helldusk_boots.description: The Helldusk Boots are a very rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to ignore Difficult Terrain, and to use a  Reaction to succeed on a Saving Throw. It also grants the Hellcrawler bonus action.

disintegrating_night_walkers.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers
disintegrating_night_walkers.description: The Disintegrating Night Walkers are story-related Boots which grant their wearer immunity to various surface effects, and also allows them to cast Misty Step once per Short Rest.

dreamsome_boots.name: Dreamsome Boots
dreamsome_boots.description: Dreamsome Boots are a pair of Boots worn by the guardian who appears in the player character's dreams.

githyanki_boots.name: Githyanki Boots
githyanki_boots.description: Githyanki Boots are a common pair of Boots.

metallic_boots.name: Metallic Boots
metallic_boots.description: Metallic Boots are a common pair of Boots.

oathbreaker_knight_boots.name: Oathbreaker Knight Boots
oathbreaker_knight_boots.description: Oathbreaker Knight Boots are a common medium-armour footwear that grants the wearer Athletics +1

boots_of_elemental_momentum.name: Boots of Elemental Momentum
boots_of_elemental_momentum.description: The Boots of Elemental Momentum are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant Momentum whenever the wearer deals elemental damage with a spell or cantrip.

boots_of_striding.name: Boots of Striding
boots_of_striding.description: The Boots of Striding are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer a burst of speed whenever they begin concentrating on a spell.

blackguard_s_greaves.name: Blackguard's Greaves
blackguard_s_greaves.description: Blackguard's Greaves are a rare pair of Greaves that grant their wearer a permanent Longstrider effect and a +1 bonus to Athletics.

dark_justiciar_boots.name: Dark Justiciar Boots
dark_justiciar_boots.description: The Dark Justiciar Boots are a rare pair of Boots that grants the wearer better Dexterity Saving Throws and the ability to cast Shadow Teleportation once per Short Rest.

the_speedy_lightfeet.name: The Speedy Lightfeet
the_speedy_lightfeet.description: The Speedy Lightfeet are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to gain Lightning Charges when Dashing in combat.

unwanted_masterwork_greaves.name: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves
unwanted_masterwork_greaves.description: Unwanted Masterwork Greaves are a rare pair of Boots that provide a bonus to Athletics. It is part of the Unwanted set.

vital_conduit_boots.name: Vital Conduit Boots
vital_conduit_boots.description: The Vital Conduit Boots are a pair of rare Boots that grants the wearer temporary Hit Points when they cast a Spell that requires Concentration.

boots_of_persistence.name: Boots of Persistence
boots_of_persistence.description: Boots of Persistence is a pair of Boots that grant their wearer permanent Freedom of Movement and Longstrider effects.

boots_of_psionic_movement.name: Boots of Psionic Movement
boots_of_psionic_movement.description: Boots of Psionic Movement are a very rare pair of Boots that allow Githyanki wearers to fly, and enhances their attacks with Psychic damage.
